title: Kentucky court keeps father 500 feet from home despite sole ownership claim after wife's death
summary_full: A Kentucky court has upheld a key decision safeguarding the welfare of two boys by ruling against their father's attempt to rescind protective orders. Although he is the property owner, the court has ordered him to maintain a 500-foot separation from his home. This ruling, following the untimely death of the boys' mother in 2025, emphasizes the priority given to their security over the father's interests.
